Last week, the band Moonshine dropped their third album, *Here Again*, a follow-up to *The Waves*. Since their last release, there have been a few lineup changes: Tom Wilcott has stepped in on bass guitar, replacing Simon McVee, who left the band last year, and Tom Simpson has joined as the new drummer.

Right from the opening track—a lively dance number—it’s clear the band is shifting away from their usual focus on slower songs. The second track keeps up the energy, even louder and heavier, while most of the later songs return to the slower style fans are accustomed to. These first two tracks will definitely catch many listeners off guard, but both have strong hit potential thanks to their quality and catchiness.

Lead singer Rob Letchford really shines on this album, hitting every note with precision.
